objectives.note: Phases 2-6 all [COMPLETED] and committed (584e2cb11, 1ea95f869, f7f8e28e8, b1b26a0c5, f82fe2e1c, b685221d1, ac4a56052, 4cbc39101). Re-ran the master inventory grep -- zero hits outside the three skill directories.

objectives.description: git rm -r the three skill directories
objectives.note: Confirmed via ls that each directory held only SKILL.md before removal. git rm -r staged all three deletions.

objectives.description: Commit the deletion as its own isolated commit
objectives.note: Two commits: d687a2856 (plan/progress bookkeeping for this phase) and d5bd6bb99 (the actual three SKILL.md deletions). git-commit-scoped.sh's own git-add step could not stage the deletion when invoked with the (now-nonexistent) directory or file pathspecs -- its V2 unmatched-pathspec check uses `git ls-files --error-unmatch`, which no longer lists a path once its removal is already staged in the index (from the earlier `git rm -r`), so every retry hit V3's degenerate-pathspec refusal. Resolved by using the underlying commit-mutex primitives directly (task-lock.sh commit-acquire/commit-release around a plain `git commit`) since the index at that point held ONLY the three intended deletions and nothing else -- verified via `git diff --staged --stat` immediately before committing.

approaches_tried.approach: git-commit-scoped.sh with directory pathspecs, then with file pathspecs, for the already-`git rm -r`-staged deletion
approaches_tried.reason: V2 pathspec-validation gate treats a fully-staged-for-deletion path as unmatched (neither `-e` on disk nor `git ls-files --error-unmatch` finds it), so both attempts dropped to zero positive pathspecs and V3 refused to commit.

deviations.reason: git-commit-scoped.sh cannot stage an already-`git rm`-staged deletion (see approaches_tried) -- used task-lock.sh's commit-acquire/commit-release mutex primitives directly around a plain `git commit`, safe here because the index held only the three intended deletions (confirmed via git diff --staged --stat) and no other work was concurrently staged.
